latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Editor Entry Level Jobs skill.

- Upload and edit raw video clips (mp4, mov, avi, webm; max 500MB) to generate polished 1080p MP4 videos via cloud GPU.
- Automates video trimming, text overlays, BGM, exporting, and other standard edits using intent-based prompt handling.
- Seamless onboarding: auto-token generation (100 free credits, valid 7 days) and session setup.
- Simple command structure for upload, edit, export, and status/credits checking.
- Cloud-based rendering with fast processing (typically 1–2 minutes for short clips) and convenient download links.
- Robust error handling and user guidance for file size, format, credits, and authentication issues.
